exclusion_reason: Direct control flow, jump-table switches, and register/memory indirect jumps recover and dispatch bit-exact, but indirect call recovery (the vtable-call return path) and function-boundary inference beyond reachable decode are declared follow-ups, so a whole real image with virtual dispatch through call cannot recompile end to end.
promotion_trigger: Promote to passing when every switch and vtable arm of a whole fixture recompiles bit-exact, indirect calls recover their return path, unknown targets fall back with a declared reason, and every code-as-data region is flagged.
expected_failing_assertion: A fixture that dispatches through an indirect call (0xff /2) reaches a form the recovery pass declares unsupported, so the whole-image switch-and-vtable trace cannot recompile end to end.
active_gate_evidence: test/recompile.test.mjs recovers a `jmp [table + index*4]` switch: it reads the pointer table from the mapped image, adds every arm as a block leader, and dispatches each arm bit-exact against the interpreter oracle (register, eflags, trace_sha256, memory_sha256, eip, stop_reason); it also pins that the dword past the table is flagged as a code-as-data boundary rather than crashing, that a register-indirect jump to an unrecovered target declares an indirect_branch_unresolved fallback with fallback_count zero, and that an indirect call is a structured refusal rather than a mistranslation.
procedure: Recover function boundary, jump table, and vtable target from the fixture image.
Recompile every recovered dispatch arm and compare each against the interpreter oracle.
Feed an unknown target and a code-as-data region and assert declared fallback and flag, never a crash.
pass_criterion: Every fixture switch and vtable arm recompiles bit-exact.
Unknown target fall back with a declared reason and code-as-data region are flagged.
